Claims this triage retired

"Quick pass, use /review"

CC 2.1.223 made /review an alias of /code-review, reversing the 2.1.202 split. review-pr/SKILL.md routed readers to a distinction CC no longer draws. Second time this paragraph has needed correcting.

"Capped at 6-12, below the new 200 ceiling"

CC 2.1.224 removed the 200-subagent-per-session cap, so the immunity argument recorded in cc-support.json on 2026-07-18 no longer holds. Spawn depth is now the only structural limit, which raises the value of #3324.
